stories.title: Strippoli con “L’estranea” correrà per la nomination all’Oscar. “Commosso, una scelta coraggiosa”

en.title: Strippoli with "L'estranea" will run for Oscar nomination. "Moved, a courageous choice"
en.summary: The horror film by 33-year-old director Paolo Strippoli has been selected to represent Italy at the Academy Awards in the best international film category. The director expressed emotion about the choice and advocated for supporting young filmmakers.

stories.title: "L'Estranea" di Paolo Strippoli correrà per l'Italia agli Oscar. Il regista: "'Scelta inaspettata"

en.title: "L'estranea" by Paolo Strippoli will run for Italy at the Oscars. The director: "An unexpected choice"
en.summary: A thriller-horror film featuring Jasmine Trinca, Romana Maggiora Vergano, Adriano Giannini and Valeria Bruni Tedeschi was selected by the selection committee to represent Italy in the International Feature Film category at the Oscars.

stories.title: “L’estranea”, Paolo Strippoli e l’orrore che può crescere al centro di ogni famiglia

en.title: "L'estranea", Paolo Strippoli and the horror that can grow at the center of every family
en.summary: The 33-year-old director competed at the Venice Film Festival where he called for greater recognition of young filmmakers' work. The film stars Jasmine Trinca, Adriano Giannini and Valeria Bruni Tedeschi.

stories.title: Operaio di 22 anni morto al Colosseo: rocciatore esperto caduto da 10 metri di altezza

en.title: 22-year-old worker dies at the Colosseum: experienced climber falls from 10 meters height
en.summary: A worker installing new lighting at the Colosseum fell while suspended on a rope system. The monument was briefly closed to tourists following the incident.

stories.title: Chi era Andrea Moretti, l'operaio che ha perso la vita sul Colosseo

en.title: Who was Andrea Moretti, the worker who died on the Colosseum
en.summary: Andrea Moretti, a 22-year-old expert rock climber from the Teramo province, died while working on the Colosseum. He was recognized for his professional skills despite his young age.

stories.title: “L’estranea” di Paolo Strippoli scelto per rappresentare l’Italia nella corsa agli Oscar

en.title: "L'Estranea" by Paolo Strippoli chosen to represent Italy in Oscar race
en.summary: Paolo Strippoli's film "L'Estranea" has been selected as Italy's official submission for the Academy Awards. The film releases in theaters on October 8.

stories.title: Ramoscelli d’ulivo e kefiah, i “preti contro il genocidio” in corteo intorno al Vaticano

en.title: Olive branches and keffiyeh, the "priests against genocide" in procession around the Vatican
en.summary: A network of over 2,000 priests across various countries formed last year in response to events in Gaza has organized a procession near the Vatican, calling for an end to war narratives and promotion of nonviolence and diplomatic solutions.

stories.title: Andrea Moretti, chi era l’operaio morto al Colosseo: la passione per i cavalli e la montagna

en.title: Andrea Moretti, who was the worker who died at the Colosseum: passion for horses and mountains
en.summary: A 22-year-old construction worker from Teramo province who specialized in high-altitude monument work died in an accident. His father had previously lost a leg in a separate incident.

stories.title: L’Estranea, l’horror di Paolo Strippoli rappresenterà l’Italia nella corsa agli Oscar

en.title: L'Estranea, Paolo Strippoli's horror film will represent Italy in the Oscar race
en.summary: An Italian horror film has been selected to compete for an Academy Award nomination. The official shortlist will be announced on December 15, with the final selection revealed on January 21.

stories.title: Andrea Moretti, il rocciatore morto a 22 anni sul Colosseo: i cavalli, l’Abruzzo, il mestiere del padre

en.title: Andrea Moretti, the climber who died at 22 on the Colosseum: horses, Abruzzo, his father's profession
en.summary: A 22-year-old specialized worker from Teramano died in a work accident. His father had previously left the same profession after a serious injury, and local authorities described the young man as cheerful and devoted to his region and animals.

stories.title: Operaio di 22 anni precipita e muore al Colosseo. Indagine per omicidio colposo: "Fune non agganciata"

en.title: 22-year-old worker falls and dies at the Colosseum. Investigation for manslaughter: "Rope not attached"
en.summary: A 22-year-old construction worker fell approximately ten meters while installing new lighting equipment at the Colosseum during overnight work. The planned inaugural ceremony with Alberto Angela scheduled for September 27 has been canceled.

stories.title: Colosseo, operaio di 22 anni muore cadendo da 10 metri: imbracatura non agganciata, Giuli chiude

en.title: Colosseum, 22-year-old worker dies falling from 10 meters: harness not attached, Giuli closes
en.summary: A young worker installing new lighting equipment at height fell during nighttime work at the Colosseum. The incident has prompted closure and prompted protests at the site.

stories.title: Corleone, la finanza entra al liceo su richiesta degli studenti

en.title: Corleone, finance enters high school at students' request
en.summary: A scientific high school has introduced a new educational program addressing student questions about managing savings and identifying financial fraud.

stories.title: Ludoil chiude l’acquisto del 51% di Isab: 1,3 miliardi di investimenti a Priolo

en.title: Ludoil completes purchase of 51% of Isab: 1.3 billion investments in Priolo
en.summary: Italian company Ludoil, owned by the Ammaturo family, has completed its acquisition of a 51% stake in the Isab refinery in Priolo from Cyprus-based Goi Energy.

stories.title: Sicurezza, dalla Lombardia alla Toscana, Sicuritalia cerca 400 guardie

en.title: Security, from Lombardy to Tuscany, Sicuritalia seeks 400 guards
en.summary: Security company Sicuritalia is recruiting 400 security guards across Italy, with significant hiring focused on transport infrastructure including airports and train stations.

stories.title: Nasce Club TV, debutto sul canale 61 e la raccolta va a 24 ORE System

en.title: Club TV is born, debut on channel 61 and advertising sales go to 24 ORE System
en.summary: Digital terrestrial channel 61 has been rebranded as Club TV, with 24 ORE System appointed as the advertising sales representative for the new television venture.

stories.title: Giornata europea del biologico, Ismea: in Italia più consumi ma operatori in lieve calo

en.title: European Organic Day, Ismea: Italy sees increased consumption but slight decline in operators
en.summary: Italy's organic product consumption value is growing, while the number of cultivated hectares and sector operators are declining, according to an Ismea report on organic agriculture.
